annotationRationale: The method interprets an absolute-value bound, restricts 2x to even integers, and counts all corresponding integer solutions.
sourceMethod: Follows the official bounds 21 < 7π < 22 and enumeration of the allowable even values of 2x.

review.mathCheck: Because \(21<7\pi<22\), the permitted even values of \(2x\) run from \(-20\) through \(20\). Thus \(x\) runs from \(-10\) through \(10\), giving 21 integers, choice E. Both signs and zero are included; the next possibilities, \(x=\pm11\), fail.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA solution 3's bound on \(7\pi\) and enumeration of even values. The candidate adds an explicit exclusion argument and converts back to x.
review.annotationCheck: Integer-solution counting and the absolute-value bound are correctly assessed. Parity is appropriate supporting knowledge. The inclusive inequality causes no endpoint ambiguity because the threshold lies strictly between consecutive integers.
